title: Add Node Placement Readiness Matrix

The placement readiness code guesses allowed child Core runtime node types instead of mirroring adapter-safe Core capability data.

The phase enables add-node mutation transport, Backend insert requests, visible WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, or active text input UI.

summary: Done: Editor commit 2be3145210eac74ecc6b82d547f6471456b36114 adds an Editor-owned node placement readiness matrix and focused tests. The matrix exposes before/after sibling slots through visible operation surfaces, inside/append readiness for real Core runtime containers, and explicit blocked reasons for columns/table/text leaves while add-node transport, WYSIWYG behavior, and visible text input remain unpromoted.
